title: Restoration Worker
experience: Candidates with previous restoration experience are preferred; however, individuals with a solid background in general construction will also be considered
description_text:
Our client, a construction company specialising in restoration works, is seeking Construction Workers to join its growing construction team in Malta. 
 The successful candidates will be involved in a variety of restoration and general construction projects, contributing to the repair, renovation, and maintenance of buildings and structures. Candidates with previous restoration experience are preferred; however, individuals with a solid background in general construction will also be considered.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Carry out general construction and restoration works across various projects.
 Assist with the repair, renovation, and maintenance of existing buildings and structures.
 Perform masonry, plastering, rendering, bricklaying, and other construction-related tasks, depending on experience.
 Prepare construction materials, tools, and work areas as required.
 Operate construction tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
 Follow instructions from site supervisors and collaborate with other team members.
 Maintain a clean and organised working environment.
 Follow all relevant health and safety regulations on construction sites.
 Requirements 
 Previous experience in the construction industry.
 Experience in restoration or renovation works will be considered a strong asset.
 Knowledge of general construction techniques and practices.
 Practical experience in masonry, plastering, bricklaying, stonework, or similar trades will be considered an advantage.
 Ability to use construction tools and equipment safely.
 Good physical fitness and a hands-on approach to work.
 Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
 Reliable, hardworking, and responsible attitude.
 Good understanding of health and safety practices.
 What's on Offer 
 Opportunity to work on a variety of restoration and construction projects.
 Stable employment within an established construction team.
 Supportive working environment.
 Opportunity to develop technical skills and gain further experience within the construction industry.
 If you have previous experience in restoration or general construction and are looking for your next opportunity in Malta, we would love to hear from you.
